additionalDrawingHole.use: Preserved in PCB outline but not assigned a post; drawing has four small-hole candidates while user specified three M2 fixing points.

mainboard.mountHoleStatus: Five fixing points selected as user-specified three corner M2 holes and two J7 M3 holes. Centers re-extracted from both PDF sides. Additional 2 mm drawing hole at (38.735,3) is explicitly unassigned pending user confirmation.
conflictsResolved: HDMI TX left / RX right follows assembly and physical silk; manual overview reverses the two labels.
Four user buttons follows SW0..SW3 assembly, manual key table and photo; prose count is inconsistent.
Type-C is power/programming/UART; no battery charging circuit is asserted.
Camera uses J4 as shown in demo and user photo; J5 remains reserved.

io.outlineStatus: 26 x 52 derived from header pitch/photo and installed overhang; not a supplied mechanical outline

bluetooth.placementStatus: Fixed beside IO as user instructed. Exact soldered offsets and installed Z are photo estimates, not measured dimensions.
bluetooth.mountStatus: soldered to IO; passive underside edge supports, no invented PCB screw holes

enclosure.screenAllowanceStatus: user already included allowance; no extra increment

displayHost.status: Sloped perimeter and recessed downward-facing connector bank follow user photos. Rear outline, slope, recess and all socket offsets are photo estimates, not measured.
displayHost.supportAttachment: Tray, top beams, diagonal braces and rear posts join the enclosure rear wall directly. No load-bearing connection to display or host.

enclosure.portsStatus: PCB connectors now face left. Existing cables enter through left-wall passages and plug into the internal sockets; these are not flush panel sockets.

mainboardMount.screw: PCB uses three M2 + two M3; printed supports all have M3 clearance bores
mainboardMount.status: Five through posts with 3.4 mm printed bores. M2/M3 nuts and shafts match actual PCB hole class; top-load nut pockets. J7 M3 spacers support the IO board. Fastener lengths and envelopes are provisional.

cableLoops.placementStatus: Latest user revision: both neck-strap eyes attach to upper solid grip rim, not to roof or sliding lid.
cableLoops.use: Neck strap attachment. Printed connection dimensions are provisional; no physical load test has been performed.

grip.sizeStatus: Latest user chair-rim reference: solid continuous rectangular flange extending from screen perimeter, with concave finger groove on camera-facing rear surface. No separate perimeter rod, open hand gap, or corner stays. Dimensions provisional.

ventilation.note: Upper rear face and both adjacent side walls. RF performance and thermal performance require physical testing.

camera.ffcSlotStatus: Narrow through-slot in circular front face below PCB lower edge z=-9.5. Ribbon leaves the lower-edge connector, bends back through slot, and runs through hollow cylinder to the enclosure; no central board slot or cylinder-bottom outlet.
camera.ribbonWidthStatus: estimated from connector/contact envelope; confirm actual FFC
camera.moduleStatus: User-confirmed 26 x 19 mm PCB; four hole centers inset 2.5 mm. Black rectangular holder, locking collar with radial screw, threaded barrel and front glass follow latest photographs. Maximum lens diameter15 and holder/collar height12 are user measurements. Total lens-tip height and detailed steps are photo estimates.

lens.status: Diameter15 and approximately12 holder/collar height supplied by user; all other stepped dimensions and lens tip extension estimated from photos, not machining data.

cap.projectionDatum: Cylinder circular mounting front face, y=186; cap foremost face y=199 when seated.
cap.status: Separate opaque screw-on cover. Continuous single-start custom trapezoid helix, not an asserted ISO thread. Female bore follows male helix with radial0.35 clearance (diametral0.7); thread fit, lead-in and material shrinkage require printing trial. 13mm is assembled forward projection; rearward skirt makes total loose-part depth26.5mm.

camera.mountStatus: Latest user redesign: no square plate. Hollow cylinder OD42 ID36, wall3, integral circular front face thickness4. From gray base front to circular front face:20 mm, cavity usable length16 mm. Rear wall and gray base have full diameter36 access bores for tightening nuts from inside the enclosure before display installation. Four circular diameter2.6 mounting bores, M1.6 hardware and washers. Hardware lengths and nut-driver envelope are provisional.
